HUR reports a Bastion coastal defense system was hit in occupied Crimea. Bastion carries Tsirkon and Oniks missiles. Group 13 operators also destroyed two fuel trucks and a command vehicle on the peninsula. https://t.co/H2LuVrwVhj https://t.co/OixfNKcsdF

Ukrainian drones hit Sochi overnight, striking the Adler oil depot owned by Rosneft and an air defense unit. The depot caught fire. In nearby Sirius, drones may have hit an S-300 or S-400 battery. Russian authorities told locals not to post photos or videos of the damage. https:/
